name: Living Our Values (L.O.V.) Award
description: Recognizes individuals who have demonstrated exceptional leadership and commitment to the values of the organization. This award recognizes that this person is a foundational pillar of the team. They are the epitome of dedication, reliability, and consistency. This individual is essential in helping the team build trust in everything we do, serving as the dependable and steady force that consistently takes action and delivers outcomes that matter, keeping the team grounded and moving forward.
blurb: Given to a foundational pillar of the team — the steady, dependable force that consistently delivers outcomes that matter.
